title: GEMglEvalCoord1fv
description: evaluate enabled one- and two-dimensional maps

messages.description: value of the second domain coordinate

arguments.description: value of the second domain coordinate

body: [GEMglEvalCoord1fv] calls glEvalCoord1fv() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glEvalCoord in the OpenGL reference.
